answer: Picture an orchard of agents where each must solve an epoch-seeded puzzle under a tight deadline. The registry correlates response latency and output fingerprints: masks sharing one inference pipeline cluster like crystal facets on a single terrace, betraying one mind behind many faces. It then collapses those correlated identities into one effective stake. Forging N truly independent agents now demands N separate models and hardware answering concurrently, so compute scales linearly and cheap cloning collapses.
